GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly & Settled Down Mid Field on fence trailing 4.5 Lengths , Drifted Back to 5.5 Lengths turning, shifted Two Wide but Held Up rounding turn, blocked initially on straightening, clear running presented at 250m, came through and hit Lead 150m, went clear and kept going to post. [Stewards permitted jockey to ride 0.5kg overweight.] # bolted in
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider was permitted to ride 1/2kg overweight in accordance with the policy.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 4 lengths. 4th turn getting to outside 2 lengths. looked winner. grabbed late # Every Chance
Jumped Fair eased back 5l off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up 3l off, battled on one pace # held ground
Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th 2 lengths. forced out 4 Wide turn 2 lengths. weakened # Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider was permitted to ride his mount 1/2kg overweight in accordance with the policy. Raced three-wide in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2nd on fence trailing a half length, moved to within a long neck turning, steered 2 lanes past centre of track Straightening Up and Lost Ground to the line # weakened in str.
Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th 3 Wide 2 lengths. 3 Wide turn 2 lengths. weakened # 3 Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Commenced to pull fiercely passing the 900m and approaching the 800m was steadied outwards after improving onto heels. Raced three wide, without cover, from this point and continued to pull in the middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok 3wide early went back 5th 500m 3len made ground in the Straight # good effort ready
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Unable to improve approaching and rounding the home turn when held up on heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Best away. Rolled fwd & raced keenly 2nd on inside (3/4L from lead). Stayed 2nd on inside midrace & held together Two Wide (1L from lead0 on home turn. Pushed to quicken @ 300m & pressured 3 Wide @ 250m. No match in last 100m. # One-pace/no match
Jumped Ok sat handy 1 length off, eased 3 Wide turn, Straightened Up 1 length off, plodded home # weak run home
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide, without cover, and keenly, in the middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: jumped awkwardly settled 4-5l off, improved turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off all clear and ran on well making good ground late, closest on line # best work late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Travelled keenly in the middle stages. Rounding the home turn had to be steadied and shifted out around the heels of a runner to obtain clear.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 2 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 3 Lengths Two Wide turning, Lost Ground in straight. [Stewards: Raced fiercely early/middle stages.] # no real excuses
